mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (POST_ID, EMPNO, AUTHOR_NAME, TITLE, CONTENT, FILE_URL, FILE_NAME, CREATED_AT) VALUES (BOARD_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{empno}, #{authorName}, #{title}, #{content}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, SYSDATE + 9/24)

INSERT INTO BOARD (POST_ID, DEPTNO, EMPNO, AUTHOR_NAME, TITLE, CONTENT, FILE_URL, FILE_NAME, CREATED_AT) VALUES (BOARD_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{deptno}, #{empno}, #{authorName}, #{title}, #{content}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, SYSDATE + 9/24)
mapper.select: SELECT POST_ID, EMPNO, DEPTNO, AUTHOR_NAME, TITLE, CONTENT, FILE_URL, FILE_NAME, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT FROM BOARD WHERE DEPTNO IS NULL ORDER BY POST_ID DESC
SELECT POST_ID, EMPNO, DEPTNO, AUTHOR_NAME, TITLE, CONTENT, FILE_URL, FILE_NAME, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT FROM BOARD WHERE DEPTNO = #{deptno} ORDER BY POST_ID DESC
SELECT POST_ID, EMPNO, DEPTNO, AUTHOR_NAME, TITLE, CONTENT, FILE_URL, FILE_NAME, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT FROM BOARD WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
SELECT POST_ID, EMPNO, DEPTNO, AUTHOR_NAME, TITLE, CONTENT, FILE_URL, FILE_NAME, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT FROM BOARD ORDER BY POST_ID DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM BOARD WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND EMPNO = #{empno}
